use_cases: Interactive landing page hero background with mouse-responsive particles
Ambient visual effect for portfolio or creative agency websites
Engaging canvas animation for SaaS product pages
Dynamic background for marketing and promotional landing pages
ai_summary: An interactive canvas-based particle animation component that renders floating dots with physics-based movement. The particles respond to mouse position and clicks, creating an engaging ambient background effect. Features high DPI support, smooth animation loop, and customizable colors and speed. Ideal for hero sections or full-page backgrounds on creative, portfolio, or SaaS websites.
